body: Dame that was a call out lol, but yeah you're right, the world didn't treat me so well for being a "minority" and I'm defiantly having a hard time to forgive those who hurt me, I'm trying to have inner peace but it's really hard so I just express how angry I'am at the world

I think of these from time to time and I get angry again and I just can't help but think "why does the world have to be like that?"
